purpose: Progressive-disclosure manifest for one governed Freedom 250 research package.
title: IMF and Currency Pricing — 2026
question: What does the IMF actually do to, with and around the price of a national currency?
bluf: The IMF does not ordinarily set the dealer quote for a currency. Its power sits around the quote: it recognizes the member's regime, classifies the actual system, models the external position, polices specified official restrictions and multiple exchange rates, and, when Fund money is involved, can make a new price-formation set-up a condition of access. Program cases cover Ethiopia, Egypt, Pakistan and Argentina; 22 bounded rulings.
use_note: Catalog entry added 2026-10-03 when International Monetary Transition was split into its sub-studies (Katie); files stay where they are and remain members of the parent study.
